name: io.github.tonyyang0504/xandr-mcp
description: Microsoft Invest (Xandr DSP, discontinued) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, pause_resume. E

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_XANDR_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Xandr / Microsoft Advertising platform API user name (an API-enabled user created through the API Onboarding Process).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_XANDR_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of that API user. POST /auth {auth: {username, password}} returns a token valid for 2 hours after the last call (24-hour hard expiry); the runtime re-authenticates on expiry or 401 (the API allows 10 successful logins per 5 minutes).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_XANDR_ADVERTISER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Advertiser id that owns the line items; required for pause_resume (PUT /line-item?id=…&advertiser_id=…).
